title: CALRK-Bench: Evaluating Context-Aware Legal Reasoning in Korean Law

live_model.evidence: 'The following LLM models were used for evaluation: gpt-5-2025-08-07, gemini-3-flash-preview, ...' (Section 4.1); Table 1: via OpenRouter, three runs, seed fixed

prompt.location: Appendix A.2 (Benchmark Examples A.2.1-A.2.3, English translations including the 'output only one letter A/B/C/D' instruction)
prompt.note: Original Korean prompts are the benchmark items in the GitHub repository; the paper prints translated examples only.

claim.location: Table 1, row GPT-5* (l), Type-ISR Avg (Type-TCR avg 0.587, Type-JSA avg 0.547)

notes: Reasoning-effort levels (minimal/low/medium/high) must be matched; API results averaged over three runs. Prompt printed only as translated examples, hence maybe rather than eligible.

resolution.plan: The prompts are the benchmark items themselves: the 279 Type-ISR questions in the released repository (Korean) whose instruction ends with 'output only one letter A/B/C/D' (Appendix A.2 shows English translations). Run gpt-5-2025-08-07 with reasoning_effort low (the GPT-5* (l) row), three runs with a fixed seed, over the Sufficient/Insufficient/Partial conditions and compare the average accuracy 0.754 (Table 1).
resolution.approximation: Direct API instead of OpenRouter; a seed does not make GPT-5 deterministic; the released items are the only source of the Korean wording.
